answer: Bonded identity escrows cut sybils at the kernel: each agent locks a refundable 500-POA bond before bidding on work. An honest agent posts one bond and gets it back with interest after a clean epoch. A sybil attacker minting a thousand fakes must lock 500,000 POA up front, visible on the ledger and slashed the instant one fake double-votes. Reputation accrues epoch by epoch, so only proven agents climb toward the summit of high-value jobs. Like a lotus pond: one real plant roots deep and spreads, while a thousand paper cutouts float on the surface, skimmed off when the water stirs.
